objections.problem: The B-A-B-A-B eighths in bar 13 fidget like a written-out trill; a held A or a simple step would phrase better.
Running eighths in both hands at once in bar 11 is a coordination hurdle for a beginner at this tempo.
The B-C-D-C turn keeps bar 12 busy; plainer note values would let the line breathe before bar 13.
C5 over the left hand's D3 on beat 2 of bar 12 makes a bare seventh that rubs slightly.

items.comment: The tune underneath is pleasant, but bars 11 to 13 are almost all eighths and bar 13 circles on A and B; I would simplify the second half.

objections.problem: The two eighth-note neighbour turns add a rhythm step; plain repeated quarters would be even simpler for a first piece.

items.comment: A clear, singable line over a simple I-IV-V bass; the neighbour turns are consistent and harmless.

objections.problem: Bars 7 and 8 circle round A twice, so the line loses direction before the leap up to D.

items.comment: A folk-like modal line that sits well on the open fifths; the steady eighths are manageable at 96 but leave little rest.

objections.problem: The F-G-F flick at the start softens the repeated-note figure that gives this phrase its bounce.

items.comment: Lively and well supported by the bass; the F at the end of bar 8 is a natural seventh over G.

objections.problem: The downbeat F5 over C4 is an accented fourth; it resolves at once down the scale, so it is fine.

items.comment: A neat scale figure over a two-note bass line; the held F over B in bar 4 is a clear dominant that resolves to E over C.
Stepwise, five-finger melody with a plain tonic-dominant bass; ideal beginner material.
